\nonumber H(X,Y)

=

-\Hess (R)(Y,Y) - 2\langle R(Y,X)Y,X\rangle

-4(∇X\Ric )(Y,Y) +4(∇Y\Ric )(Y,X)

- 2\frac{\partial \Ric }{\partial \tau }(Y,Y) + 2\abs \Ric (Y,·)2 - \frac{1}{\tau }\Ric (Y,Y),\nonumber .

We have equality in Equation (Hessin) if and only if the adapted vector field $Y$ is also a ${\mathcal L}$-Jacobi field.
